con lluvia que con sol, ¿verdad?
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Es que cuando llueve es más difícil
que te encuentren, ¡porque la lluvia
camufla el olor!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Así que, en un día lluvioso como el
de hoy, fijo que no te encuentra
nadie. {{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡Qué movida!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}J'étais en train d'me dire{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0017:}}Jouer à
cache-cache quand y pleut ou quand
y fait beau, ça a rien à voir, hein ?!
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Bah ouais, la pluie dissimule les
odeurs, donc c'est plus facile de
s'planquer !
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Du coup, ceux qu'ont l'nez fin
s'retrouvent pas plus avancés qu'les
autres, aujourd'hui,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Ehi, mi è venuta in mente una cosa
a caso{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0017:}} Il nascondino cambia
un sacco se piove o c'è il sole, no?
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Cioè, la pioggia confonde gli odori,
quindi è più facile nascondersi!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}In un giorno così, anche chi ha un
naso formidabile avrebbe difficoltà
a trovare gli altri, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Ich spuck's jetzt einfach aus{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0017:}}
Findeste auch, dass Verstecken
im Regen viel schwieriger ist?
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Hallo?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Wenn's regnet, kann man die
Leute nicht so gut riechen, und das
eigentliche Verstecken ist einfacher!
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Heute wird dich also keiner so
schnell finden,{{TAG:0003:0023:}} {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Snowy days have a particular smell.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:002B:}}They just feel really pure, like they
could hide the smelliest smell in the
whole wide world!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000F:}}But it's still not OK to go around all
stinky. You still need to take baths,
OK?{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}} OK, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}?
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Los días de nieve tienen un olor
muy característico.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Es todo así como muy puro.
¡Yo creo que la nieve tapa hasta
el olor más desagradable del mundo!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Pero eso no quiere decir que no
haya que lavarse... ¡No es plan!
{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}¿Vale, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}?
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Les jours de neige ont une{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} odeur
particulière, nan ?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Comme une douce fragrance de
pureté que même la plus immonde
puanteur ne saurait altérer...!
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Hum ! Bref, c'est pas une raison
pour arrêter d'se laver, OK ?{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} {{TAG:0003:0006:}}OK,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0005:0007:}} ?!
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Quando nevica, c'è un odore
particolare nell'aria.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Quasi di perfezione e purezza,
in grado di coprire anche il tanfo
più orribile al mondo!
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Questo non vuol dire che si può
andare in giro puzzolenti. Bisogna
lavarsi, eh?{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}} OK, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}?
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Man kann echt riechen, dass Schnee
in der Luft liegt.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Es riecht so frisch, kein Gestank
der Welt könnte den Frischeduft
vermiesen!
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Das ist keine Ausrede, müffelnd
in der Gegend rumzuwackeln.
{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Verstanden, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}?

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Sunny days in spring have a unique,
springy smell.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0017:}}Do you think maybe
it's all the cherry blossoms?
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}That aroma gets me super excited!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}My festival senses start getting all
tingly, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Los días soleados de primavera
tienen un olor así como muy...
primaveral, ¿no?{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0017:}}¿Tú crees que es porque los árboles
florecen? {{TAG:0003:0000:}}¡Es que me encanta el olor
a flores!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}No hay nada que me dé más ganas
de irme de fiesta, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}¡{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Au printemps, les jours ensoleillés
ont comme une odeur unique...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0017:}}Ça
vient p't'être des fleurs d'cerisier ?
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}En tout cas, j'adore !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}Ça m'donne
trop envie d'faire la fiesta,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}I giorni di sole in primavera hanno
un odore proprio... primaverile.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Pensi che sia per via dei petali
di ciliegio? {{TAG:0003:0000:}}Quel profumo mi
mette sempre l'allegria addosso!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}I miei sensi si risvegliano
in occasioni come questa,
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}İlkbaharın güneşli günleri kendine özgü,
baharlık bir koku taşır.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0017:}}Acaba kiraz
çiçeklerinden mi?
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}O koku beni fena coşturuyor!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Festival radarım hemen titreşmeye
başlıyor, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Oye, el otro día {{TAG:0005:0003:}} me
enseñó un truquito que lo rompe.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Cuando no se te ocurra de qué
hablar, ¡habla del tiempo! ¿A que
es una idea muy original?{{TAG:0009:0001:170018001600}}
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Hi hi, l'autre jour, {{TAG:0005:0003:}} m'a
appris un truc bon à savoir...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Quand tu sais plus quoi dire pendant
une conversation, parle du temps
qu'y fait !{{TAG:0009:0001:170018001600}}

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}I didn't expect to hear that kind of
thing, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}¡La verdad es que no esperaba
que dijese algo así, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Auf so was wär ICH natürlich nie
selbst gekommen, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Senden böyle bir şey duymayı beklemiyordum,
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Oh! But I'm not saying we're out
of stuff to talk about, OK?{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0024:}}There's no way the two of us could
ever run out of stuff to talk about!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Oye, pero no quiere decir que
nosotros no tengamos de qué
hablar, ¿eh?{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Conmigo es imposible que
pase eso, ¡ji, ji, ji!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Te méprends pas ! Chuis pas en
train de dire qu'notre discussion est
dans une impasse, hein !
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}J'vois pas comment on pourrait
s'retrouver à court de trucs à
s'raconter, toi et moi !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Oh! Ma non volevo dire che non
abbiamo più argomenti di cui
parlare, OK?
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Tra noi non succederà mai!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0012:}}Das soll jetzt nicht heißen, dass
mir bei dir die Themen ausgehn,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
okay?
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Wir zwei könnten uns bis ans Ende
der Welt gegenseitig die Ohren
abkauen!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Ah! Ama konuşacak konumuz bitti demiyorum,
tamam mı?{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0024:}}İkimizin konuşacak şeyi asla bitmez!

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Claro, es que a ver, ¿a quién no
le gusta hablar del tiempo?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0024:}}¡Yo creo que es un truco
alucinante, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ouaip, comme ça, même si tu sors
une grosse ânerie, tu risques pas
d'froisser grand monde !
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Vraiment infaillible c'te technique,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0005:0007:}} !

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}When you're looking up at the sky{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
sometimes balloons just come flying
outta nowhere, right?
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}What I wanna know is{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}who the heck
is sending 'em out?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}But I guess it's cool for a mystery
to stay a mystery sometimes!
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}¿No te pasa a veces que estás
mirando el cielo{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
y aparecen globos de la nada?
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Yo lo que quiero saber es{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
¿quién narices los manda?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡A lo mejor es una señal de que
en algún sitio se está celebrando
una fiesta, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Ces ballons qui flottent dans l'ciel
et qui sortent de nulle part{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Tu les
as déjà vus, nan ?
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Le truc qui m'turlupine{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} c'est
qu'j'me demande bien qui peut les
envoyer ?!
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Remarque, si on avait des réponses
à toutes nos questions, j'imagine
qu'on s'ennuierait,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}I'm sure you already know this, but
if you want to watch the meteor
shower tonight, press up on .
And when you see a shooting star{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
{{TAG:0007:000A:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}press  to make a wish!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}I don't know if it's true or not, but
I hear a present might come down
to you if your wish reaches the star!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Bueno, seguro que ya lo sabes...
pero si quieres ver la lluvia de
estrellas, ¡pulsa arriba en !
Ah, y si ves una estrella fugaz{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
{{TAG:0007:000A:}}¡pulsa  para pedir un deseo!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}No sé si es verdad o mentira,
pero dicen que, si le llega tu deseo
a la estrella, recibes un regalo, ¡ji, ji!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Tu dois déjà l'savoir, mais s'tu veux
profiter d'la pluie d'étoiles filantes,
faut qu't'appuies sur .
Si tu repères une étoile filante qui
t'semble être la bonne{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0007:000A:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}appuie
sur  pour faire un vœu !
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Chais pas si c'est vrai, mais à ce
qu'on dit, tu reçois un cadeau si ton
vœu atteint l'étoile !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Lo saprai già, ma se vuoi vedere
le stelle cadenti più tardi, premi 
verso l'alto!
Quando ne vedi una{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
{{TAG:0007:000A:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}premi  per esprimere
un desiderio!
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Ho sentito dire che potresti
ricevere un regalo, se il desiderio
raggiunge la stella! Chissà?!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Das weißte sicher schon, aber wenn
du nachts Sternschnuppen sehen
willst, musste mit  hochgucken.
Siehste eine{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0007:000A:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}dann drück schnell
, um dir was zu wünschen!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0020:}}Keine Ahnung, ob's stimmt, aber
wenn der Wunsch die Sterne er-
reicht, kannste was abstauben!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Bunu zaten biliyorsundur ama bu gece meteor
yağmurunu izlemek istiyorsan 
üzerinde yukarı bas.
Bir kayan yıldız görünce{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
{{TAG:0007:000A:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}dilek tutmak için  tuşuna bas!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}
Doğru mu bilmiyorum ama dileğin yıldıza ulaşırsa
sana bir hediye gelebilirmiş!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Hey, we got important things to
focus on tonight!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0000:}}We're gonna see
some shooting stars!
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}You better have a wish ready! If you
don't wish for anything, those stars
are gonna be wasted, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}¡Oye, que esta noche hay cosas
más importantes de las que
preocuparse!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0000:}}¡La lluvia de estrellas!
Habrás pensado ya un deseo, ¿no?
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Es que menudo desperdicio de
estrellas si no pides nada...
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Au programme d'ce soir : pluie
d'étoiles filantes,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}J'espère que t'as un vœu tout prêt
sous la main... Faudrait pas qu'ces
p'tites étoiles tombent pour rien !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Ehi, dobbiamo concentrarci su delle
cose importanti stasera!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0000:}}Dobbiamo
vedere delle stelle cadenti!
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Ti conviene prepararti un desiderio
da esprimere! Altrimenti queste
stelle saranno inutili, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Heute Nacht haben wir Wichtiges
vor!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0000:}}Wir gehen Sternschnuppen-
gucken!
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Und vergiss nicht, 'nen Wunsch
auf Lager zu haben! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Hey, bu gece önemli işimiz var!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0000:}}Kayan
yıldızları göreceğiz!
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Dileğini hazır et! Hiçbir şey
dilemezsen o yıldızlar
boşa gider, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Darn it! Whenever I see a shooting
star, I get so flustered I can't get
my wish out in time, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}¡Buf! ¡Siempre que veo una lluvia de
estrellas me emociono tanto que no
consigo pedir un deseo a tiempo!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Bon sang ! À chaque fois qu'j'repère
une étoile, elle file si vite qu'j'ai pas
l'temps d'faire mon vœu !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Ma no!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Quando vedo una stella cadente,
non riesco mai a esprimere in tempo
il mio desiderio, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}So 'n Käse!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Immer wenn ich 'ne
Sternschnuppe seh, stotter ich und
krieg meinen Wunsch nicht raus!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Hay aksi! Ne zaman kayan yıldız görsem öyle
heyecanlanıyorum ki dileğimi
zamanında söyleyemiyorum,
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Cuando estoy viendo una lluvia de
estrellas tengo que contener el
aliento de la emoción.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Anda que cualquiera que me vea...
¡Se va a pensar que soy una panoli,
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!{{TAG:0003:0025:}}
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Quando guardo in alto nell'attesa
di una stella cadente, trattengo
sempre il fiato.
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Chissà cosa pensano le stelle di me!
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!{{TAG:0003:0025:}}
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Wenn ich Sternschnuppen anschaue,
versuch ich immer möglichst cool
zu gucken. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Noch cooler als sonst!
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Damit mein Wunsch auch ja in
Erfüllung geht! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!{{TAG:0003:0025:}}

EN:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Awwww!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} I was trying to look up at
the sky without blinking, but my
eyes get so tired!
{{TAG:0003:000A:}}But if I close my eyes, I just know
I'm gonna miss a shooting star!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}¡Aaaay!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Nada, no hay manera
de mirar al cielo sin pestañear...
¡Se me cansa la vista!
{{TAG:0003:000A:}}Pero claro, si cierro los ojos,
¡seguro que me pierdo alguna
estrella fugaz!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Argh !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} J'essaie d'fixer le ciel sans
cligner des yeux, mais j'réussis
juste à m'les fatiguer !
{{TAG:0003:000A:}}Et si maintenant j'les ferme, j'parie
qu'j'vais louper une étoile filante !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Ma nooo!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ho provato a guardare
il cielo senza chiudere gli occhi,
ma non ce l'ho fatta!
{{TAG:0003:000A:}}Se li chiudo però, sono sicura
di perdermi una stella cadente!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Ayyy!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Gözümü kırpmadan gökyüzüne bakmaya
çalışıyordum ama gözlerim çok yoruluyor!
{{TAG:0003:000A:}}Ama gözümü kapatırsam kesin
bir kayan yıldızı kaçıracağım!
